title: VP Product — Wed AM Priorities & Rapid Follow-ups
content:
Wed AM quick scratchpad — dodging long email thread, keeping focused.

Top intent for today:
- Align on Dedicated capacity rollout timeline for Q2 pilot (need decision on option A vs B by EOD Fri).
- Unblock SRE on autoscale policy testing — confirm test window and rollback plan.
- Get buy-in from Legal on revised private-deploy contract clause (data residency paragraph).

Meetings and prep (ordered):
1) 08:30 standup w/ product leadership (15m) — 3 slides: pilot scope, risk areas, ask: approve canary dates.
   Prep Qs: what is minimal success for pilot? metric to gate rollback?
2) 10:00 1:1 with Miguel (30m) — discuss MVE for Optimize recommendations UX. Bring sample telemetry.
3) 11:30 vendor sync (30m) — GPU provider follow-up; confirm quantization perf matrix they promised.
4) 15:00 All-hands sync (20m) — 2 min update on Dedicated launch cadence. Keep it high-level.

Action items / rapid follow-ups (priority order):
- [ ] Send one-paragraph decision memo for pilot options to execs (owner: me) — due Thu 12:00.
- [ ] Ping SRE for autoscale test slot and post link to PROD-4123 (owner: Miguel) — due today.
- [ ] Draft redline for contract clause and share w/ Legal (owner: Rina) — due Fri.
- [ ] Ask Data to surface top 5 tenants by token spend for last 30d (owner: analytics) — add to meeting.

Notes-to-self / parking lot:
- If option B chosen, need extra cluster for region failover — cost estimate required.
- Watch for regressions in streaming latency after kernel change; set alert: streaming.lat_p95 > 120ms.
- Remind myself to narrate fallback story for customer meetings — how routing + quantized variants keep app online.

Conversation snippets to capture (copy-paste when sending follow-ups):
- "Can we carve a two-week hard freeze window for the canary so ops can bake it? If not, we need an automated rollback plan."
- "Legal: data residency clause is about control plane logs; we should offer HSM/KMS optionality rather than a blanket clause."

Quick decisions to make (today):
- Pilot window: Mar 24–Apr 7 (canary first week) — choose yes/no.
- Autoscale policy: preserve headroom of 20% vs aggressive 5% (ops preference: conservative).

End-of-day deliverables:
- Short memo to execs (sent)
- Post meeting note in slack:#prod-leads with action owners and links
- Update PROD-4123 with test timeline

Mood/energy: mid — need coffee before 10:00.

Random reminders (notes-to-self):
- Move Q2 hiring forecast to Confluence page under VP hiring folder.
- Add 10m buffer before All-hands for quick sync w/ comms.

If time: sketch a 1-page customer-facing FAQ about Dedicated vs Private benefits for sales deck (priority low).

---
Revision history (brief):
2026-03-12: created initial list, flagged pilot decision.
2026-03-13: updated action owners after sync with Miguel.
_notes: personal scratchpad — informal phrasing, shorthand permitted
